title: silene caroliniana var. pensylvanica
intro: Silene caroliniana var. pensylvanica, commonly known as fire pink, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of fire pink are attributed to its antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
